claim_boundary: Task optimization fits unknown modeled dynamics on a fixed MaleCNS-derived graph. It does not train or modify biological connectivity and is not evidence that a living fly learned the task.

seed_namespace.final_test_rule: Training/development seeds are >2.1e9; final held-out/OOD seeds are generated only from 1..1,999,999,999. The namespaces are disjoint by construction.

connectome_sensory_interface.rationale: Matheson et al. 2022 found odor-sensitive FB tangential inputs including FB5AB without significant odor-direction tuning, while PFNa/PFNp/PFNm carry wind direction into hDeltaC. Physical bilateral antenna values remain recorded but their instantaneous difference is not injected as a directional connectome cue.
connectome_sensory_interface.claim_boundary: This remains a modeled sensory interface until a peripheral olfactory bridge is separately body-ID-qualified.

objective.privileged_training_signal: source distance is available only to the optimizer's reward calculation and is never passed to the controller at inference

tau_s.meaning: global modeled neural relaxation time constant

recurrent_gain.meaning: global scale on recurrent connectome drive

odor_gain.meaning: tied bilateral gain on modeled nondirectional odor-presence drive

wind_forward_gain.meaning: gain on positive body-forward airflow drive

wind_backward_gain.meaning: gain on negative body-forward airflow drive

forbidden_training_freedom: changing body IDs or role membership during optimization
injecting instantaneous left-right odor difference as a directional FB cue in v1
using source coordinates, distance, plume ground truth, or final-test outcomes as controller inputs

matched_control_rule.training_budget: identical seed split, parameter bounds, population size, generation count, objective, and optimizer seed for every topology
matched_control_rule.primary_development_comparison: intact validation performance versus mean performance of separately trained rewired topologies
matched_control_rule.warning: A trained intact model must never be compared against untrained rewires as evidence that topology helps.

development_gate.interpretation: This gate only decides whether task optimization is useful enough to carry forward. It is not the final scientific claim.

final_test_policy: No final held-out or OOD episode may be evaluated until the training algorithm, parameterization, trained parameter files, E002 checks, and final manifest are frozen.
